correctness.rationale: With W=M_b T_a, the Hilbert–Schmidt coefficient tr(W* P_g) is exactly the specified ambiguity value. Under conjugation by M_s T_r the coefficient has character zeta^(sa-rb). These characters are distinct and can isolate each nonzero coefficient by Fourier averaging; the complex trace pairing is nondegenerate, so this is precisely the complex lift rank. The constant and modulus-squared terms of the ambiguity expansion give deltas on b=0 and b=2da, respectively; completing the squares gives z G_d zeta^(-b^2/(4d)) and its shifted conjugate. Consequently the nonorigin real-locus deficits are Q=-p and Q=-p|z|^2, and the remaining cancellation depends only on j=b^2/(2d)-ab. Off the two lines, j is nonzero and each j corresponds to one a per nonzero b. The norm at (0,0) is positive because the window cannot vanish at both 0 and 1. At z=0 there are p nonzero coefficients. For the unit seed, Q=2 sqrt(p) and h=kappa cannot lie in S_p as -1 is not a p-th root of unity. Both line deficits imply |z|=1 and p<=2 sqrt(p), excluding p>=5. At p=3,d=1,z=1+zeta, G=1+2zeta gives Q=-3 and z/conj(z)=zeta, so all three disjoint packets do occur. Rank deficiency is not asserted to imply nonlinear phase-retrieval failure.
residual_risks: The recorded 8184 cyclotomic identities corroborate only the tested primes and slope pairs. All-prime rank and phase-retrieval sufficiency rely on the algebra, not that enumeration.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general criteria alone are only framework; the stronger applicable exact family result is the prior one-coordinate classification, which also treats nonprime cyclic orders.

evidence: For w=1+zG_d the prior real loci are 2 Re(w)=2-p and |w|^2=1; these give Q=-p and Q=-p|z|^2 respectively. The prior root parameter -(w-1)/(conj(w)-1) is -kappa h; in prime order each nonidentity p-th root contributes exactly p-1 and the identity contributes zero. The uniform window w=1 corresponds to z=0, and w=1+sqrt(p) to the unit-amplitude seed.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Substitution supplies all three indicators, including simultaneous deficits and the special prime. The entire asserted rank stratification is already implied under exact unitary equivalence.

evidence: Let F use the negative Fourier phase and C_r multiply by zeta^(r x^2). The Weyl-covariant unitary C_{-1/(4d)} F C_{-d} maps the two-chirp window to (conj(G_d)/sqrt(p)) (1+z G_d delta_0), by a completed square. Thus the altered coordinate of the earlier window is w=1+z G_d.
Both Fourier and chirp multiplication conjugate Weyl shifts to permuted Weyl shifts up to phases; projector orbits, and therefore lift ranks, are equivalent under this unitary.
